review_comments.body: **Children keep removed inheritance** Setting `isInheritable` to `false` leaves already-read child notes using the attribute. Both update paths change the cached attribute before calling `save()`. The save handler then sees `isAffectingSubtree === false` and clears only the parent’s cache, unless another note inherits from it through a relation. Children keep the attribute in their cached lists. Clear the subtree when turning inheritance off. Add a test that reads a child’s attributes before and after the change. **Knowledge Base Used:** [Core domain and common contracts](https://app.greptile.com/triliumnotes/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/triliumnext/trilium/-/docs/core-domain-and-common-contracts.md)

**Helper precedes the entry point** The new `upsertAttribute` helper sits between the imports and `attributeTools`. The repository guide requires helpers below the primary export they support, so readers reach the entry point first. Move the helper below the export to satisfy this requirement before merging. **Context Used:** CLAUDE.md ([source](https://github.com/triliumnext/trilium/blob/main/CLAUDE.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

**Imports break the required order** The new `AttributeType` package import follows relative imports. The repository guide requires package imports before relative imports, sorted within each group. Move it above the relative imports and sort the affected groups to satisfy this requirement before merging. **Context Used:** CLAUDE.md ([source](https://github.com/triliumnext/trilium/blob/main/CLAUDE.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

**Later updates change another attribute** Changing `isInheritable` moves the updated attribute behind its same-name siblings. `addAttribute()` appends the replacement to `ownedAttributes`; passing `existing.position` does not preserve that array’s order. For example, changing inheritance on the first of two `tag` labels makes the second label become first. A later `set_attribute` call without `attributeId` then overwrites that sibling instead of the attribute just updated. Keep the replacement in the old attribute’s array slot and test this with multiple same-name attributes.
